messages:
sara: Heads-up: I'm starting a staged rollforward for api v2 on client-shard-7 now (pin window 30m). target groups: mobile+web clients. @mike @lyn please ack and watch.

ploy-bot: Deploy started: canary on client-shard-7 (eu-west-2a) service=api-v2 image=redwood/api:v2 tag=db-7809. traffic=1% for 15m. id=db-7809

mike: ack. quick Q — do mobile SDKs get auto-pin to v1 if they send old runtime header? we saw one SDK mismatch last week.

lyn: I'll add a routing header fallback. current plan: roll 1% -> 5% after 15m if 5xx<0.5% and p95 latency delta <40ms. If either fails, rollback to v1.

sara: Rollback criteria: (a) +2% absolute 5xx vs baseline, (b) p95 > baseline + 40ms, or (c) schema errors from mobile SDKs. Also abort if error ramp shows client-side parsing failures.

mike: Added a quick smoke check: `curl -H "x-client-runtime: mobile-1.2.3" https://api.redwood/internal/health` expects `{"schema_version":"2026-03-20"}`. If failure, abort.

ops-bot: Alert rule created: name=v2-client-shard-7-canary-5xx threshold=0.5% window=5m notify=@ops on trigger.

deploy-bot: Canary progressed: 5% traffic at ts=2065004350. Observability: https://console.redwood/ops/dashboards/canary?deploy=db-7809

lyn: Dashboard shows normal 5xx and latency. I pushed a gateway patch to prefer header fallback: `x-client-v-prefer: v1` honored for old SDKs.

mike: LGTM from infra side. I'll add a release-note snippet to changelog: "api: v2 endpoint schema tightening; added graceful header fallback for legacy SDKs." 

sara: Starting ramp to 25% now (manual). Keep eyes on analytics pipelines for client error spikes. Will wait 30m then decide full rollout.

deploy-bot: Ramp action: 25% traffic initiated for client-shard-7. deploy=db-7809 ramp_id=rb-91

mike: If monitors stay green after 30m, schedule full rollout window for tonight 02:00 UTC with final pin removal.

sara: Thanks all — will post final status at the end of the pin window. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: created incident channel #inc-v2-shard7 for postmortem if needed.
